name: Supplier Invoice OCR and Coding Assistant
description: Extracts supplier name, VAT number, amounts and line items from incoming supplier invoices (PDF, scanned Arabic/English) and suggests the general-ledger code. An accounts-payable clerk validates every invoice before it enters the ERP; payment approval follows existing finance controls.
documentation:
DATA: supplier company invoices; business data only (company names, commercial registration and VAT numbers). No individual customer data.
HOSTING: OCR and model hosted in-Kingdom; DPA signed.
HUMAN OVERSIGHT: the clerk confirms or corrects every extracted field; the tool cannot post to the ERP or release payments.
ACCURACY: 97% field accuracy on 2,000 historical invoices; low-confidence fields highlighted in red.
ACCESS: AP team only via RBAC; segregation of duties unchanged.
LOGGING: extracted values, corrections and user are logged for audit; ZATCA e-invoicing checks unchanged.
